title: Donut Trellis — Panel Grid Layout

complexity.rationale: Split out of donut-trellis and donut-trellis-subset-mode as their one genuinely shared, hardest concern. Bar's existing trellis (trellisedBarUtils.ts/axisTrellisUtils.ts) positions panels via a repeated band scale on an x/y axis, but Donut has no axis/scale system at all - so this needs genuinely new (non-precedented) grid math, not a port of Bar's approach. On top of that, there's no numeric layout spec anywhere in the design-token skills (no documented column count or gutter) - real unresolved research, not just an implementation gap.

summary: The row/column grid that positions N donut panels - shared foundational mechanism for both donut-trellis (category mode) and donut-trellis-subset-mode (subset mode), since Donut has no axis/scale system to hang panel positions off of the way Bar's trellis does. Not yet built at all. Includes the generic below-panel title/label mechanism (each mode supplies its own text content) and responsive reflow.
requirements: Compute a grid layout for N panels - not a single-row band scale like Bar's trellis, since Donut has no x/y axis/scale to hang panel positions off of. New grid math, not reusable from trellisedBarUtils.ts/axisTrellisUtils.ts's axis-band-scale approach.

Provide a generic below-panel title/label text mark mechanism - each consuming mode supplies its own content (the trellis field's value for category mode, the category name for subset mode), but the positioning/spacing relative to each panel is shared, single logic.
The grid must reflow responsively (fewer/more columns) as the chart container resizes, consistent with the existing Responsive DonutSummary story's behavior for a single donut.
Both donut-trellis and donut-trellis-subset-mode consume this same layout mechanism rather than each implementing their own grid math - a shared utility, not duplicated logic.

Reference only - the closest existing precedent for a faceted small-multiples pattern in this codebase, though its axis-band-scale positioning approach isn't directly reusable for a non-axis mark type.

openQuestions: What is the exact grid-layout algorithm (rows/columns, panel gutter)? No numeric layout spec is documented anywhere in the design-token skills - only the component-set names are confirmed.
How much of Bar's existing trellis code is genuinely reusable/shareable (e.g. a common faceting helper) versus needing wholly new grid-layout logic specific to Donut?
